description_en: Queries a list of users that have permissions on the specified instance
description_zh: 调用此API可以获取拥有指定实例权限的用户列表
name: ListAuthorizedUsersForInstance

parameters.help_en: The ID of the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the instance ID

parameters.help_en: The keyword that is used for the search
